text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Furioso! You're up early today 
too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even though you commute from an apartment, 
you've never once been late—that's 
amazing! You must work really hard at 
waking up early!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. Being late is simply 
unacceptable for an Umamusume of 
Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That's a wonderful mindset, *ssu*! I 
wish everyone else would follow your 
example, *ssu*!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... *snore*...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Tran-san. Please wake up. Wake up 
already, hey.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ngh...? Ah, crap... Did I doze off?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Julio. That really saved me~... 
*yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Julio's pretty admirable, huh. 
I've never seen her fall asleep in class 
or anything.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Like, aren't you always on edge? 
...Doesn't being so serious all the time 
tire you out?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not tired. ...Also, no private 
conversations during class."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Okaay. ...You're definitely still way too 
tense, huh.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Gh...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, whatever is the matter? Does 
something hurt...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...No, there is no need for concern. I am 
quite alright.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(There's no way I can tell them... that my 
stomach is about to growl from hunger...!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, at least—here. Have a 
bite of this and take a breather, okay?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you. Snacking during training 
is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, talking about food made me even 
hungrier!? Ngh... Silence...! You noisy 
stomach...!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder why. Today, for some reason... 
mmgh... my eyes feel blinky and dry...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Well, that's only natural... This is 
enemy territory. As long as I can't let my 
guard down, fatigue will accumulate...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Still, all that's left is the meeting 
with Trainer. Once I get through that—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Let's go.

After finishing our usual training, while 
discussing future plans with Furioso...

For someone who is always on high alert, 
this was a rare sight indeed. So—I decided 
to let her sleep for just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...*snooze*, *snooze*... Trainer... Next, 
that... sauce ramen...
choice_data_list:
Haha. I wonder if she's eating something 
delicious?

Fufu. I wonder if they're eating something 
delicious?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ngha... Huh? Where am I... Wait?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer? Why are you in my 
apartment...? ...Huh???
choice_data_list: Furioso. This is the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!? S-Sorry! Showing such an... 
unbecoming, shameful display as a 
representative of Funabashi...!"

I tell Furioso that there's no need to 
worry. Bearing the weight of her hometown 
must be exhausting at times. So, at the 
very least... around me—
choice_data_list:
It's okay to doze off. You can let your 
guard down.

It's okay to doze off. You can let your 
guard down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right. Even in enemy 
territory, only this place...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: You, of all people—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.
choice_data_list:
You were up early, but did you get enough 
rest?

Take it easy until you get your strength 
back

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's plenty.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, you could have woken me 
sooner... You would have been well within 
your rights to scold me."
choice_data_list:
Because you looked so comfortable 
sleeping...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...D-Don't stare at my sleeping face. 
Even if you are my Trainer, I'll get 
mad... Jeez."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, I couldn't possibly... I'd feel bad 
tying up your time, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
In that case, I'm fine. I'll just work a 
little bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well, then... um... If you really don't 
mind, I will take you up on that...
